title: Silver Generation Officers Involved in Outreach and Home Visit Activities
what_it_is: Silver Generation Officers Involved in Outreach and Home Visit Activities

sections.label: Silver Generation Office outreach engagements
sections.summary: SGO deployed about 3,000 staff and volunteers as ambassadors, making over one million engagements since 2014 and adapting to COVID-19 in 2020 and 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Silver Generation Office (SGO) has deployed about 3,000 staff and volunteers as Silver Generation Ambassadors (SGAs) to proactively reach out to seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since 2014, SGO has made over one million engagements.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In 2020, SGO adapted their engagement approaches during the COVID-19 pandemic and made 140,000 home visits, complemented by an additional 140,000 telephone check-ins.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In 2021, SGO pivoted to encouraging and assisting our seniors’ COVID-19 vaccinations, reaching out to 168,000 and 11,000 seniors through home visits and telephone check-ins respectively.

sections.label: Pioneer Generation Office origins
sections.summary: SGO was previously the Pioneer Generation Office, established to reach Pioneers about the PG package and Government schemes, MediShield and CHAS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: SGO was previously known as the Pioneer Generation Office (PGO) and it was established to reach out to Pioneers relating to the PG package and tell them about the various Government schemes, MediShield and CHAS.

sections.label: SGO preventive health partnerships
sections.summary: SGO works with health and care partners on preventive health messaging, aiming to expand visits to at-risk, frail or socially isolated seniors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are a lot of efforts that we are doing with other partners as well, to make sure that this engagement continues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We recognise that SGO's mandate is now to go beyond just communicating Government schemes to better address their needs in a more targeted manner.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, SGO has been working with the Regional Health Systems clusters, primary care and community care Partners to instil preventive health messaging in seniors in the community, so that they can also augment the support and engagement that they, through the SGAs, have been giving.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are hoping to continue to build on this relationship, so that we can expand that effort and also look at targeting areas, especially with more frequent visits to at-risk seniors, including those who are frail or have weak social support.
